scenes.caption:
Docs drift: one page gets updated, the page that repeats it does not.
Docs Drift lists the places where a project's docs contradict themselves.

fastify: the hooks page says request.body is undefined. The TypeScript page says null.
The code says undefined. Both lines link to the pinned commit.
typeorm: the docs show an update() call that the code does not have.

redux-toolkit: one page says refetchOnFocus, three others say refetchOnMount.
The code handles focus.

The fixes are with the maintainers: {prs_open} pull requests open, covering {prs_defects} defects.
Patches for the other {not_sent} are ready.

captions.text:
Run it on a repository. It pairs passages that restate each other
and asks Clocked /compare which pairs conflict.

/grounding and a second /compare with the pair swapped decide what is listed.
/rerank finds where else the fact is stated.
This run replays recorded API answers: no key, no credits, same result.

scenes.caption:
{projects} real projects: {pairs} pairs read, {listed} listed, {real} real.
On {val_projects} projects scanned after the rules were fixed: {val_real} of {val_listed}. It is a list to review, not a verdict.
What it got wrong is on the page too.
